
'''Yamada Shrine''' (山田神社) refers to various {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines}} located across Japan.

* '''Kanagawa Prefecture'''
** {{ill|Yamada Shrine (Yokohama City)|ja|山田神社 (横浜市)}} - Located in Minamiyamada Town, {{ill|Tsuzuki-ku, Yokohama|en|Tsuzuki-ku, Yokohama|qid=Q1153920|lt=Tsuzuki Ward}}, Yokohama City. A shrine designated for offerings and former village shrine.

* '''Osaka Prefecture'''
** {{ill|Yamada Shrine (Hirataka)|ja|山田神社 (枚方市山之上)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamada Shrine (Hirakata City Yamanoue)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11470582}} - Located in Yamanoue, {{ill|Hirakata|en|Hirakata|qid=Q270912|lt=Hirakata City}}. A former village shrine.
** {{ill|Yamada Shrine|ja|山田神社 (枚方市田口)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamada Shrine (Hirakata City Taguchi)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11470583}} - Located in Taguchi, Hirakata City. A former village shrine.

* '''Yamaguchi Prefecture'''
** {{ill|Yamada Shrine (Yamaguchi City)|ja|山田神社 (山口市)}} - Located in Ato Jifuku Kami, {{ill|Yamaguchi (city)|en|Yamaguchi (city)|qid=Q207876|lt=Yamaguchi City}}.
** '''Yamada Shrine (Suō Province)''' - A shrine listed in the historical records of Suō Province.
*** {{ill|Yamada Shrine (Suō-Ōshima Town)|ja|山田神社 (周防大島町)}} - Located in Sotoiri, Suō-Ōshima Town, Ōshima District, Yamaguchi Prefecture. A candidate for the above shrine.
*** {{ill|Yamada Shrine (Shikano Town)|ja|山田神社 (鹿野町)}} - Previously located in Shikano Town, now part of Shunan City, Yamaguchi Prefecture. Referred to as {{ill|Nisho Yamada Shrine|ja|二所山田神社}}.

* '''Kagawa Prefecture'''
** {{ill|Yamada Shrine (Kanonji City)|ja|山田神社 (観音寺市)}} - Located in Kuda Town, {{ill|Kan'onji, Kagawa|en|Kan'onji, Kagawa|qid=Q861270|lt=Kanonji City}}. A former village shrine and a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}}.
